rule: Each row is three runs: a left-colour run of length L (possibly 0) touching the left edge, a middle-colour run, and a right-colour run starting at rs and touching the right edge (rs == W means no right run). Let m = min rs over all rows. In each row, k = min(L, rs - m) left cells are removed from the left run. The middle run slides left by k and keeps its width. The k cells are placed just before the unchanged right run.
scope: Three-run row profiles move left-colour cells against a ragged right boundary using the globally leftmost start of that boundary. Construct partial moves, full moves with remaining gaps, blocked rows, absent right runs and exact fills; infer colour roles from strict edge-column majorities. Default grids6..30 by5..30, explicit sampling4..30 by2..30, with left caps and right-edge spreads scaling with width. Canonical rows are reconstructed from latent lengths.
constraints: Three canonical pairs exact;1000 independent seeds20000..20999 match the archived transform.

authored_scope: Samples width (default 6..22, explicit 4..30), height (default 5..22, explicit 2..30), three distinct colours, and a per-row (L, rs) profile built directly. The profile always has an anchor row and a partial-move row. Depending on height and width it also has a full-move-with-gap row (height >= 3, width >= 5), and optionally a blocked row (L=0), a no-right-run row and an exact-fill row. Non-square and non-fixture sizes are synthetic extensions. The generator does not support rows without a middle run, more than three colours, or noise.
authored_constraints: 0 <= L < rs <= W in every row, so the middle run is at least one cell wide
the left colour is a strict majority of column 0 and the right colour is a strict majority of the last column, so the colour roles are identifiable
at least one row has k > 0, so no identity pair is produced
the three colours are distinct ints in 0..9; bools and non-int values are rejected
all dimensions are in range: sampling width 4..30, height 2..30; explicit rows 1..30
